keep_playing_why: In A I lost the boss stage by hoarding coins, then changed how I spent, called waves early and used the burner and swat timing, and won. Escalating topping costs, three different active verbs and armoured knights that need a counter made me play differently by minute five. B kept me on a fetch chain with one obvious next step until the boss, which has one good idea (match the vane to the heart colour) buried under camera trouble.
better_made_why: A reads clearly on a phone, with clean feedback (combos, bites left, orders, boss lid-off phase), consistent audio and no bugs beyond a brief black dim while a build panel opens. B has lovely art but I hit a blank teal frame at gusts, an overlapping chart tab, objective text that did not match my state, the camera clipping into the boss and a trunk, and a stall around the carving that wedged the harness.
furthest_A: Stage 3 (The Sink), wave 7 of 10, 17 of 20 bites left. Stage 1 cleared with 3 stars (12,640). Stage 2 (Stovetop) lost once to the Jar boss, then cleared with 3 stars (35,710, Jar beaten). Did not reach the Cheese Grater.
